description: This file defines function interfaces and structures related to handling command-line options for diff formats of merge commits in a version control system, likely part of a larger diff or merge utility.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configures diff merge options based on a string value.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress_m_parsing
methods.description: Suppresses parsing of the '-m' option in diff merges context.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options related to diff merges and updates rev_info accordingly.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppresses diff merge processing on given rev_info.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Sets diff merge defaults to consider only the first parent in merge commits.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Configures diff merges to default to dense combined format.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Sets the dense combined format if it has not already been set.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Initializes or configures revision information for diff merges.
